title: 活动报道的事实组织
goal: 选择有依据的活动事实，按概述、过程和反馈组织报道。

points.label: 选择构成活动报道的相关事实
按概述和过程组织报道

sources.title: 大学英语四级（CET-4）：课表
sources.used: 写作部分的课题范围、知识点与教学规格

cards.title: 结构
rows: 事件概述
先写时间、地点、人物和活动，不先下评价。
On Saturday morning, twelve student volunteers cleaned the signs along the community walking route.
主要过程
按先后顺序写关键行动，先写准备，再写结果。
The volunteers first checked the route map and then divided the signs among three groups.
参与者反馈
写明评价来自谁。一个人的评价不写成所有人的。
One resident said that the newly cleaned signs made the route easier to follow.
后续安排
没有记录的日期和结果不补写。计划写明是谁说的。
The organizer said that another cleaning session was planned, but no date had been fixed.

cards.title: 常用表达
rows: 说明举行
was held 后面接记录中的时间和地点。
A workshop on reading historical photographs was held in the seminar room on Tuesday afternoon.
明确参与者
took part in 写实际参加的人数，不写计划人数。
Twenty students took part in the workshop and examined copies of old campus photographs.
承接过程
began with 引出活动的第一个环节，用在过程段开头。
The workshop began with a comparison of two photographs taken from the same position.
引入后续
was followed by 引出下一个环节，只表示先后。
The comparison was followed by a group discussion about details visible in the photographs.
归属反馈
according to 或 said that 标明信息来源。
According to one participant, comparing the images helped make changes in the campus layout clearer.
区分议论
报道写别人说了什么，不写作者自己的主张。
Opinion: Every workshop should use photographs. / Report: One student recommended using photographs again.

body.box:
Twelve student volunteers cleaned the signs along the Brookside community walking route on Saturday morning. The activity was organized by the college volunteer association after residents reported that several direction signs were difficult to read.

Before starting, the volunteers checked a route map with a community worker. They then divided into three groups and cleaned the signs with the materials provided. Signs with damaged lettering were recorded for later attention rather than repainted without permission. By noon, the groups had finished cleaning the agreed section and submitted their notes to the community office.

One resident said that the cleaned signs were easier to follow. The association's coordinator thanked the volunteers and said that the office would review the damaged signs separately. No date for further work was announced.

body.p: 首段写明时间、地点、参与者和活动。第二段分开写已完成的清洁和留待处理的破损文字。末段的评价写明来自居民，后续安排写明来自协调人，计划没有写成结果。

body.box:
A lecture on evaluating online information took place in Room 318 on Wednesday afternoon. The campus learning center organized the event for students preparing their first research assignments. Thirty students attended, according to the registration record.

The speaker began by comparing two descriptions of the same fictional study. One named its author and explained its evidence, while the other offered a strong conclusion without showing the source. Students worked in pairs to identify the missing information. A question session followed, during which the speaker discussed how to record the source of a claim for later checking.

Several participants said that the comparison made the checking process clearer. The center collected written comments after the session and said it would use them when planning future activities. It did not announce another lecture date.

body.p: 讲座报道先概述，再按比较、结对分析、问答的顺序写过程。Several participants said 写明了反馈的来源和范围。不能改写成所有听众都已掌握查证方法。

body.box:
Which sentence belongs in the lecture report?
1. Every student should attend information lectures before using any website.
2. All attendees mastered source evaluation during the first comparison.
3. Another lecture will certainly take place in Room 318 next Wednesday.
4. Some participants reported that the comparison clarified the checking process.

body.p: 第四项保留了 Several participants said 的来源和范围。第一项是个人主张，第二项夸大了效果，第三项把没有公布的日期写成了定论。

cards.title: 常见错误
rows: 议论代替事实
All students should volunteer every Saturday.
这是作者的主张，不是本次活动的记录。
时间错置
The signs were cleaned before the map was checked.
原文先核对路线，再分组清洁。
计划当作完成
The damaged lettering was fully repainted.
原文只是记下破损，留待以后处理，没有重新刷字。
反馈扩大
Every resident praised the completed route.
原文只有 One resident 的反馈。
信息来源遗漏
All the workshop methods were effective.
这是作者的判断，没有写明来源。

groups.text: On Monday afternoon, nine student volunteers sorted donated winter coats in the community center for a local clothing exchange.

items.stem: Which sentence preserves the reported facts?
options: Nine residents donated winter coats at the community center on Monday morning.
Nine students organized donated coats at the community center on Monday afternoon.
Nine students distributed every donated coat at the community center on Monday afternoon.
Nine volunteers bought winter coats for the community center on Monday morning.
items.why: nine student volunteers sorted donated winter coats 写明了人物和动作，地点是 community center，时间是 Monday afternoon，与第二项一致。

groups.text: At a seminar, students examined sample interview questions before working in pairs to revise their own questions.

items.stem: Which order should the process paragraph preserve?
options: Revise personal questions, then examine the samples used at the seminar.
Work in pairs, then introduce samples after all revisions are complete.
Examine sample questions, then revise personal questions in pairs.
Revise the samples, then replace the students' personal interview questions.
items.why: examined ... before working in pairs 说明先分析范例问题，再两人一组修改自己的问题，即第三项。

groups.text: One participant said the first-aid demonstration was clear, while the organizer collected comments for planning another session.

items.stem: Which sentence keeps the feedback within its stated scope?
options: A participant described the demonstration as easy to understand.
Every participant agreed that another session was unnecessary.
The organizer confirmed that all participants had mastered first aid.
A participant announced the date of the next demonstration.
items.why: One participant said the first-aid demonstration was clear 只是一个参与者的评价。第一项照这个范围转述。

groups.text: A campus astronomy club held an indoor talk after clouds prevented an evening observation, then invited questions from members.

items.stem: Which statement functions as an event overview?
options: Members asked questions after the club's indoor talk had ended.
Clouds prevented the club's planned observation of the evening sky.
The question session followed the astronomy club's indoor presentation.
The club replaced its cloudy evening observation with an indoor talk.
items.why: 概述要写明谁举办了什么活动。第四项写出了俱乐部、原安排的变化和实际举行的讲座。第二项只交代了背景。

groups.text: On Friday, the college craft society held a demonstration of paper folding in the common room. Eighteen students attended. The demonstrator first showed a basic fold, then guided students through a small box design. One student said the slow demonstration made the sequence clearer. The society collected the finished boxes for a display, but had not chosen a display date.

items.stem: Which statement can be included as a confirmed result?
options: A display date was chosen after the students completed their boxes.
The completed boxes were gathered for a display with no date yet fixed.
Every student said the folding sequence was easy to follow.
Eighteen students demonstrated their box designs before learning the basic fold.
items.why: collected the finished boxes 是已完成的行动，had not chosen a display date 说明日期未定。第二项两点都保留了。

items.stem: Complete a sentence describing the opening stage of the demonstration.
items.why: began with a demonstration 写出第一个环节。fold used in the box design 说明这种折法后面用在盒子上。

groups.text: On Sunday morning, sixteen student volunteers helped the Meadow Lane community library label a collection of donated board books. Staff first explained the labeling system. The volunteers then checked each book and added a label before placing it on the assigned shelf. A librarian said the labels made the collection easier to organize. Damaged books were set aside for staff review.

items.stem: Which opening accurately summarizes the activity?
options: Sixteen library staff repaired donated books at Meadow Lane on Sunday morning.
Sixteen students delivered new shelves to Meadow Lane on Sunday morning.
Sixteen students labeled donated board books at Meadow Lane on Sunday morning.
Sixteen volunteers reviewed damaged labels after leaving Meadow Lane on Sunday morning.
items.why: sixteen student volunteers ... label a collection of donated board books 写明了人物、活动和对象，与第三项一致。第一项把志愿者换成了馆员。

items.stem: Which detail belongs in the process after staff explained the system?
options: Volunteers checked and labeled books before putting them on assigned shelves.
A librarian said the labels made the collection easier to organize.
Sixteen student volunteers arrived for the Sunday morning library activity.
Damaged books were repaired and returned before the labeling system was explained.
items.why: The volunteers then checked each book and added a label before placing it 是讲解之后的环节，即第一项。第二项是馆员的反馈，不属于过程。

items.stem: Complete a sentence preserving the action recorded for damaged books.
items.why: set the damaged books aside for review 写的是先放在一边等待审查，没有写成已经修好。

items.stem: Complete the sentence introducing the first stage of the activity.
items.why: began with an explanation 对应 Staff first explained。先讲解贴标签的方法，志愿者再处理书。

groups.text: A lecture on preparing interview questions was held in the media room on Thursday evening. Twenty-four students from the college attended. The speaker first compared broad and focused questions. Students then revised a question in pairs, and the lecture ended with a discussion of their revisions. Two students said the comparison helped them make their questions more specific.

items.stem: Which sentence reports feedback with the correct attribution?
options: The speaker said every student had completed a successful interview.
All twenty-four students praised the final discussion as the main benefit.
Two students said their interviews had already produced better answers.
Two participants said the comparison made their questions more precise.
items.why: Two students said the comparison helped them make their questions more specific 写明了人数和效果，即第四项。第三项说采访已有结果，原文没有提到采访。

items.stem: Which sequence fits the body of this report?
options: Revise questions in pairs, compare question types, discuss the revisions.
Compare question types, revise a question in pairs, discuss the revisions.
Discuss completed interviews, revise questions, introduce the question types.
Compare question types, discuss completed interviews, revise the attendance record.
items.why: first compared、then revised、ended with a discussion 依次是比较、修改、讨论，即第二项。

items.stem: Complete a factual sentence naming the participants in the lecture.
items.why: was attended by 引出参加者。twenty-four 与原文的人数一致。

items.stem: Complete a sentence marking the transition from comparison to practice.
items.why: was followed by 引出下一个环节。paired exercise in revising 概括了两人一组修改问题。
